description: This PHP class 'Serve' is a console command for serving documentation via a local development server. It extends a 'DauxCommand' class and uses Symfony Console components to configure command options for host and port, then executes by setting up and starting a PHP built-in server, passing configuration data through environment variables and temporary files.

classes.name: Serve
classes.description: A console command class that initiates a local server to serve documentation using PHP's built-in server, configurations, and environment variables.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the command name, description, and options (host and port).

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the command to start the development server, sets environment variables, prepares configuration, and runs the PHP built-in server.
